schedule: list then ThumbnailImage/PreviewImage/JpgFromRaw; each 2 warmups then 10 samples; then each tag collision then each tag preview-limit; fixed 54 attempts; no retries/trims/adaptive stops
consumer: concurrently drained bounded in-memory JSON stdout/stderr capture, 4096-byte chunks; direct CLI process; extraction bytes to fresh local files; validation outside timing
cache: fresh application process each attempt; source/preflight expected-resource hashing exposes warm OS cache; OS/device caches uncontrolled; server not applicable; no eviction

storage.scope: same local C: NTFS volume for source, executable, captures and extracted outputs
storage.durability: native extraction includes file flush/sync and no-clobber hard-link publication; no directory/storage durability qualification

environment.localeTimezone: Python process locale inherited; Windows Eastern time per task context
environment.backgroundLoad: uncontrolled shared developer workstation; parallel documentation/verification work possible

telemetry: elapsed only; CPU/memory/physical I/O/first-result/allocated scratch unavailable, null with reasons in record
statistics: success-conditional per-operation/tag min, median, nearest-rank p95, max and total elapsed ns; n=10; warmups/controls/failed/censored excluded from latency distribution and retained in denominator
limits: local authored operation smoke; no real-camera baseline, decoder, comparative speed, cold-cache, defaults or release/regression thresholds
supersession: Earlier complete 54-attempt setup series retained privately; superseded solely to normalize source LF and rustfmt fixture generator before this final frozen series.
